name: Xanthic-Pediment
description: The sea here is thick with dissolved metals, so sunsets burn green and gold above the waves. Beneath them wait a subterranean ocean, and everything the light never reaches.

Standing still, you feel the cold air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself. Something scrubbed this biosphere clean within a geological instant. The rocks remember it as a thin black line.
Nothing about the radiation hotspot appears on any natural-phenomena registry. The leading research institutions classify it as 'pending,' which is science's word for afraid.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
